unit.why: A short tale about R. Yeshaya of Dinovitz miraculously receiving a cantor's sweet voice after praying for it.

stories.start_quote: פ״א סיפר איך שהרה״ק ר׳ ישעי׳ מדיניוויץ
stories.summary_en: R. Yeshaya of Dinovitz, who had no singing voice, heard a cantor singing sweetly and asked God for that voice so he could serve Him with it; the voice passed from the cantor to him, and from then on he was a great singer.

quotes: ושמע חון אחד משורר בקול ערב מאד
tags.why: singing and the gift of melody are the subject

quotes: ונתחלף הקול מהחזן והי' לר׳ ישעי׳ זצ"ל
tags.why: the voice miraculously passes from the cantor to the tsaddik

quotes: אמר רבש"ע אם תתן לי זה הקול ערב אעבדך בזה
פ״א סיפר איך שהרה״ק ר׳ ישעי׳ מדיניוויץ
